title: Word Frequency Counter
h1: Word Frequency Counter — Most Used Words
seoTitle: Word Frequency Counter — Count Repeated Words Online
description: Count how often each word appears in any text, with optional case folding and a minimum length. Sorted results stay in your browser and are never uploaded.
intro: Paste an essay, article, or notes and see which words dominate. Case can be ignored, and short tokens can be filtered out before the ranking.
blurb: Rank the words in a text by how often they appear, privately in the browser.

controls.label: Text
controls.value: The cat sat on the mat. The cat sat.

howItWorks: Paste the text you want to inspect. Punctuation is separated from words automatically.
Choose whether uppercase and lowercase should count as the same word, and set a minimum length.
Press Count words to get a frequency table sorted from most common to least common.
examples: In “The cat sat on the mat. The cat sat.” the word the appears twice when case is ignored.
Set minimum length to 4 to skip short function words while reviewing a draft.
Writers use the ranking to spot repeated words before editing.

faq.a: Runs of letters and numbers are counted. Punctuation and extra spaces are ignored, so “mat.” and “mat” match.

faq.q: Does ignore case affect accented letters?
faq.a: Yes. Matching uses Unicode-aware lowercasing, so accented letters stay intact and compare case-insensitively.

faq.q: Is my writing sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Counting happens locally in the page, and the text is not stored by ToolNova.
